title: Verblunsky coefficients, CMV matrices and numerical invariants of homogeneous bidisc submodules
summary: Let $[p]$ be the principal submodule generated by a polynomial in $H^2(\mathbb D^2)$. For homogeneous $p$, the homogeneous slices of $[p]$ admit a weighted OPUC model in which the two wandering vectors are an orthonormal polynomial and its reversal. We show that the associated Verblunsky coefficients determine the singular values of the wandering-projection product and the restricted cross-commutator, as well as the non-zero spectrum of the core operator.
